evidence.support_text: A human repeated insult patch test (HRIPT) was conducted with 10% 2,2,5-trimethyl-5-pentylcyclopentanone in petrolatum (5540 µg/cm²) on 50 volunteers. During induction, 0.2 ml of the material was applied to a 3/4" square Webril swatch under occlusion to the upper arm for 24 h, repeated every 48 h for nine applications over three weeks. After a 12-day rest, a challenge patch was applied to a previously unexposed site and scored at 24, 48, and 72 h. No reactions were observed in any volunteer.
